channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: North Chapel in Liberty Station reopens, with historic character preserved
item.description: “We’re just so honored to be part of restoring this part of Liberty Station’s history... We’re really thankful for the opportunity.”

item.title: San Diego Museum of Art puts legacy on display with centennial exhibits through the fall
item.description: The official commemoration takes place on Feb. 28 with a community birthday fest, cake party and more, but exhibits begin to open Saturday.

item.title: San Diegan takes on new extreme athletic challenge: Antarctica
item.description: A 2011 graduate of Point Loma High School, McKaveney recently returned from one of his most interesting and challenging adventures.

item.title: Rady Children’s Hospital ends gender-affirming surgeries, medications
item.description: "This was a very difficult decision, made to ensure we can continue serving all children and families across the communities we serve."

item.title: Patrick Henry High clubs find fun way to raise money with latest ‘food frenzy’
item.description: "This is a great opportunity for clubs to help fund different types of activities they want to participate in..."

item.title: City secures funding for storm drains in Southcrest, hit hard by 2024 floods
item.description: The allocation for Southcrest, included in Congress' fiscal year 2026 spending package, was secured by local Congressional representatives.

item.title: Federal immigration officers claim they have sweeping power to enter homes without warrant
item.description: Advocates say the move collides with Fourth Amendment protections and upends years of advice given to immigrant communities.

item.title: Fleetwood Max, The McCharmlys, strings and swing: Top concerts this week
item.description: Cover bands, anniversary shows, New Wave but with strings, and much more await San Diego's music scenesters this week.

item.title: Balboa Park backers call on city to reconsider parking fees amid signs that admissions are dropping
item.description: Declines offer a “very early and loud” sign that without free parking, many residents may not be able to afford trips to Balboa Park, one said.

item.title: James Beard Awards set sights on two San Diego County chefs, Convoy speakeasy
item.description: Two San Diego County chefs and a Convoy Street cocktail bar are among the coveted James Beard Foundation Award semifinalists announced Wednesday, marking another strong showing for the region on the national culinary stage.
